M1.name: LOSSLESS_STRUCTURAL
M1.condition: Only v1 tier allowed to create an automatically applied mutation. Requires current commit/tree/file CID/source-map identity, exact mutable spans, typed edits, deterministic linking, stale rejection, and preservation of unaffected bytes where supported.

M2.name: SOUND_SEMANTIC_ABSTRACTION
M2.condition: Planning, routing, impact/test/proof selection, contract propagation, and likely-edit discovery. Every summary names derivation, qualified fragment, assumptions, omitted semantics, and completeness witness. Mutation requires exact M1 expansion.

M3.name: LEARNED_SEMANTIC_COMPRESSION
M3.condition: experimental_advisory_only; no execution, proof, release, or blocking authority in v1.

This common mutation namespace does not transfer canonical semantic, exact-byte storage, or patch-admission authority between repositories.
canonical_versus_projection_authority_bo.authority_isolation: A local projection alias is not canonical identity; this receipt transfers no semantic, storage, or admission authority and creates no competing owner.

existing_equivalents.finding: The compiler is the sole owner of SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1. It compiles producer-authoritative capsules from a sealed ISI view and a bindings-owned relevant projection. It never rediscovers binding scope and never treats another capsule CID as a dependency.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Reuse capsule identity as datasets-owned. Do not promote the binding projection to capsule or CanonicalCodeIR identity.

existing_equivalents.projection: kit CIDv1 put/get of exact bytes
existing_equivalents.finding: Datasets ProofCarryingArtifact@1 binds semantic/contract/proof/test/static/security/policy/authority lineage and rejects forged CIDs, stale roots, missing lineage, and producer flags. Kit put/get reject byte/CID disagreement and require CIDv1 base32. Kit does not judge semantic soundness.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Reuse this split for later projection-byte storage. Do not create a competing proof store or treat kit CID equality as semantic admission.

existing_equivalents.split: ProducerBoundSource exact bytes versus later M1 source link
existing_equivalents.canonical: ProducerBoundSource@1 admits exact current bytes and spans
existing_equivalents.finding: ProducerBoundSource@1 reverifies source bytes against CID and fails closed on wrong producer state, missing blob, CID mismatch, TOCTOU reread mismatch, and path fallback. It does not rewrite source and is not SourceLinkReceipt@1.
existing_equivalents.reuse_decision: Reuse as the exact-byte admission surface for later M1 linking. Do not treat it as the linker.

existing_equivalents.split: MCP++ wire contract versus semantic authority
existing_equivalents.finding: MCP++ owns closed wire schemas. External clients may request or propose typed patches but cannot choose authority identities, override freshness, apply or admit patches, or promote advisory abstractions.

relevant_controls: Canonical semantic identity is datasets-owned and CID-bound where the existing contract already emits CIDv1.
Kit verifies supplied bytes against CIDv1 base32 identity and rejects claimed-CID disagreement.
ContextPack CID derives from schema, interface, repository state, exact source CIDs, capsule CIDs, scanned tree, and freshness.
DuckDBASTStore projected ast_cid must equal ASTRecord.cid and projected source_cid must equal provenance.source_cid.
MCP++ CID behavior schema is RFC 8785 canonicalization-bound and rejects pseudo-CID and Qm new mints.
A local projection alias is never substituted for a canonical semantic CID.
